verdict.rationale: Kick can 'view and manage' bills synced in real time from Ramp or BILL, but the docs explicitly note Kick does not capture bills natively or execute vendor payments itself — it relies on synced data from external AP tools, and there is no documented approval-routing workflow within Kick. Missing for 10: native bill capture/OCR intake, an in-app approval-routing step, and evidence of Kick itself scheduling/executing payments (currently pass-through from Ramp/BILL).
